title: Balanced Sampling in Stochastic Multi-objective Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2610.35551v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In stochastic multi-objective bandits, Pareto optimal arms may represent different trade-offs among objectives. Balanced sampling across them is important in practical settings such as online advertising. Yet, there seems to be little consensus on how to measure fairness, to our best knowledge. Achieving fairness is also tough as the set of Pareto optimal arms is unknown, and early sampling decisions may create imbalances that are difficult to erase afterwards. We measure unfairness by the KL divergence from the uniform distribution over the true Pareto set to the empirical measure induced by the sampling trajectory. Nicely, this measure admits an exact decomposition that separates the cost of sampling suboptimal arms from the imbalance among Pareto optimal arms. With a recursive form for unfairness, we develop \emph{adaptive top-two sampling}, which combines sampling counts and empirical evidence of Pareto membership to define a gain

translated_title: 随机多目标老虎机中的平衡采样
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.35551v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在随机多目标老虎机问题中，帕累托最优臂可能代表各目标之间不同的权衡关系。在实际场景（如在线广告）中，对这些臂进行平衡采样非常重要。然而，据我们所知，关于如何衡量公平性目前似乎缺乏共识。实现公平性也十分困难，因为帕累托最优臂的集合是未知的，而且早期的采样决策可能造成难以在事后消除的不平衡。我们通过从真实帕累托集上的均匀分布到由采样轨迹诱导的经验分布之间的KL散度来衡量不公平性。该度量的一大优点是允许精确分解，从而将采样次优臂的成本与帕累托最优臂之间的不平衡分离开来。利用不公平性的递归形式，我们提出了自适应前二采样，该方法结合采样计数与帕累托隶属关系的经验证据来定义一个增益……
tldr: 该论文提出用KL散度来衡量多目标老虎机中帕累托最优臂采样的不公平性，并基于其递归分解结构设计了结合采样计数与帕累托隶属经验证据的自适应前二采样算法，以实现帕累托最优臂之间的平衡采样。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes measuring unfairness in sampling Pareto optimal arms of stochastic multi-objective bandits via KL divergence, and develops an adaptive top-two sampling algorithm that combines sampling counts with empirical evidence of Pareto membership to achieve balanced sampling across Pareto optimal arms.
